text:
mina: landed v4.1-int4-dropin to staging (build bld-512). quick heads up: solid cost/latency wins but a small hit on FAQ MRR and answer-fidelity in short-answer slice. wanted to propose a canary gating plan.

ryan: metrics?

mina: smoke snapshot smk-20260326-03:
```
baseline: prod v4.0
candidate: v4.1-int4-dropin
samples: faq N=15k, short-answer N=9k
faq_MRR: 0.312 -> 0.305 (delta -2.24%, p=0.045)
short_answer_fidelity: 0.889 -> 0.865 (delta -2.69%, KS p=0.02)
latency_p95: 132ms -> 98ms (win)
```

sofia: KS on fidelity p=0.02 suggests distributional shift. policy is immediate rollback if core-customer metric <= -2% & p<=0.05. borderline but triggers.

ryan: can we avoid full rollback with targeted routing? propose: 1) pin critical FAQ/helpdesk routes to prod v4.0, 2) run SPRT-based canary on short-answer slice for 4h at 2% traffic, 3) 24h quiet-burn at 0.5% if SPRT inconclusive. immediate rollback if any hourly snapshot shows delta <= -2% & p<=0.05 or SPRT accepts harm.

metrics-bot: smk-20260326-03 results saved. composite delta CI: [-3.1%,-1.4%] for combined customer-facing metrics. artifact: gs://rwd-smokes/smk-20260326-03.tar.gz

mina: ops: example route pin config I'll push before run. also require structured top-50 token diffs and first-10k user feedback events logged. tagging @sofia for concordance job.

ops-bot: scheduling canary smk-20260326-03 at 2026-03-27T01:00Z per request. rollout config saved as rollout-5119990000.json. alerts: sprt-alert, hourly-snapshot, ewma(alpha=0.2) on short_answer_fidelity. notifications to #eng-ml & #release-war-room.

sofia: i'll run the concordance job and produce top-50 discrepant examples. ryan: approve the plan?

ryan: approve with one addendum: add route-level opt-out for Dedicated customers and require manual opt-in promotion for Dedicated.

mina: noted. will update rollout policy and post dashboard links in the runbook. closing prep thread.
